title: Logarithm-Free Uniform Rates for Treated Outcome Regression under Weak Overlap
banked_reason: Second authorized intrinsic-cube extension study window reached BUILD_CAP (10) with three remaining proof obligations.

proof_attempt_summary: The corrected intrinsic-cube paper passed D0.5 at field tier, and formalization proved several qid-local and reusable lemmas, including ordered treated mass, causal identification, and intrinsic cube completion. The remaining controlled positive-order cube extension was attempted in two authorized ten-round study windows; the second ended with three dependent sorrys for collar smoothness, quantitative collar control, and the global extension. This bank records a Lean substrate shortfall, not a mathematical refutation; retry after the generic extension theorem is proved without sorry.
tldr: Global propensity tails restrict how many covariate regions can be severely treatment-starved but allow arbitrarily ill-conditioned treated geometry within ordinary neighborhoods. A fixed equal-cell unisolvent template removes that geometric instability, while a treatment-count selector adapts to unknown \(\gamma\). On the common class with bounded treated conditional means and uniformly conditional-sub-Gaussian residuals, one explicit estimator attains expected supremum risk \(n^{-\beta/(2\beta+d\gamma/(\gamma-1))}\) without a logarithmic loss. A dedicated source leaf now records every remaining hypothesis in Dorn's Assumptions 1 and 2 used by the affine transfer; the resulting corollary deletes Assumption 3 and strengthens the Gaussian uniform-design upper criterion to expected supremum loss. A bounded Bernoulli pair supplies the matching converse for the larger common class.
gap: Dorn derives the target exponent, unknown-\(\gamma\) adaptation, and the no-log supremum result only under a local propensity anti-concentration condition used to control polynomial Gram matrices. The paper explicitly leaves removal of that condition open, and its Gaussian lower experiment does not establish the bounded-outcome converse required here.
fill: The equal-cell unisolvent estimator gives every occupied template cell the same total weight, the count selector adapts to unknown overlap strength without estimating the propensity, and the ordered variance series replaces a crude union bound. The main theorem pairs the resulting upper risk with a bounded causal lower construction and a strict-class witness.
